title: Astral character: pattern ranges are UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes
description: The same call pattern over a source containing an emoji pins the offset contract. UTF-16 range is [10,22); the equivalent UTF-8 byte range is [10,24). An implementation returning byte offsets must fail this fixture.

offset_contract.note: The emoji is one code point, two UTF-16 code units, four UTF-8 bytes. The fixture pins the UTF-16 range; the UTF-8 range is recorded only as a counter-example.

must_not: return capture node range [14,20] for the emoji string
corrupt the emoji in the replacement output

provenance.derivation: Executed ensureGrammarLoaded('typescript') + compilePattern/findMatches/renderTemplateReplacement/applyReplacements on 2026-10-30; UTF-8 range computed from the same source.
provenance.engine: TS pattern port over web-tree-sitter WASM
